# BlinkSend

> Fast, free, peer-to-peer file and clipboard sharing between phones and computers. No account needed.

Repository: https://github.com/ghostySRC/BlinkSend
Default branch: main
Package version: 0.2.0
License: MIT
Runtime: Node.js 20+, browser JavaScript, WebRTC data channels

## Product model

BlinkSend is a two-peer, self-hosted transfer app. The Node.js process serves the UI, coordinates WebRTC signaling, generates QR codes, issues short-lived protected ICE/TURN credentials, maps temporary manual pairing codes to random rooms, optionally maintains five-minute Nearby discovery metadata, and exposes optional token-protected Prometheus metrics. Normal file contents travel over the WebRTC data channel rather than through the BlinkSend application server.

The current server state is intentionally single-process/in-memory. Do not claim multi-replica support unless shared signaling, room state, pairing codes, discovery state, and abuse limits are implemented.

## Main capabilities

- Send / Receive entry flow
- random 128-bit invite links
- QR generation and in-app QR scanning
- eight-character manual pairing codes that expire after 10 minutes
- opt-in same-observed-address Nearby discovery
- optional local device names
- mutual six-digit DTLS-fingerprint verification before new transfers
- SHA-256 file verification with bounded per-file retry
- numbered chunks, compact chunk bitmaps, missing-range resume, and network-change ICE recovery
- restart-safe resume where persistent File System Access handles are supported
- File System Access / OPFS large-file streaming
- folder transfer, recursive drag-and-drop, and nested folder reconstruction
- path traversal rejection for incoming relative paths
- clipboard/text transfer up to 256 KB using small UTF-8 control frames
- paste-to-send and native Web Share
- installable PWA + local Web Share Target staging
- automatic 512 KiB connection calibration, adaptive WebRTC buffering, Direct/Relay quality, smoothed speed, ETA, and batch progress
- local-only transfer history and optional completion feedback
- protected TURN credential endpoint
- server rate limits and malformed-signaling controls
- explicit reverse-proxy trust via TRUST_PROXY
- token-protected Prometheus metrics
- graceful SIGTERM/SIGINT drain with WebSocket restart notification
- hardened Docker/Compose deployment
- deterministic protocol benchmark + real signaling load benchmark

## Important files

- README.md — current behavior, setup, deployment, limits, test commands
- SECURITY.md — threat model and public-deployment cautions
- AGENTS.md — coding-agent invariants
- server.js — HTTP server, signaling, manual pairing, Nearby, metrics, ICE/TURN, abuse controls, shutdown
- public/index.html — UI
- public/app.js — pairing, WebRTC transfer protocol, resume, batching and UX state
- public/protocol.js — pure transfer helpers
- public/sha256.js — incremental SHA-256
- public/persistence.js — IndexedDB resume sessions + local history
- public/manifest.webmanifest / public/sw.js — PWA and local Share Target
- Dockerfile / compose.yaml / deploy/Caddyfile.example — deployment
- scripts/benchmark.mjs — deterministic transfer-structure benchmark
- scripts/load-benchmark.mjs — 10-room / 20-WebSocket signaling load benchmark
- scripts/run-tests.mjs — explicit test file discovery
- test/ — protocol, signaling, production-server, security and PWA tests
- .github/workflows/ci.yml — tests, benchmarks, Docker build, container smoke test

## Development

```bash
npm ci
npm test
npm run bench
npm run loadtest
npm start
```

## Server environment

- PORT
- TURN_URLS / TURN_SECRET
- TRUST_PROXY — enable only behind a trusted proxy that overwrites X-Forwarded-For
- METRICS_TOKEN — enables /metrics
- LOG_FORMAT — text or json
- LOG_LEVEL — info or silent

## Security invariants

1. At most two signaling peers per room.
2. Manual/Nearby codes never replace fingerprint verification.
3. New transfers stay locked until both browsers confirm the six-digit DTLS-fingerprint-derived code.
4. Normal file bytes stay off the BlinkSend application server.
5. Completed files must pass SHA-256.
6. Incoming paths reject traversal.
7. TURN credentials require a short-lived room-issued token.
8. TRUST_PROXY is off by default.
9. /metrics is disabled unless a token is configured and never emits room IDs or client IP labels.
10. Share Target staging remains device-local.

## AI / coding-agent guidance

Read README.md, SECURITY.md, AGENTS.md, server.js, public/app.js, public/protocol.js, and relevant tests before protocol/security changes. Keep user-facing flows simple. Update README.md in the same logical commit as user-visible or deployment behavior. Run the full test/benchmark/load-test suite for server or transfer-protocol changes.
